say:1:1423404001:1.text: Those poor guards are doing their best to tough it out. You can see it on their faces...
say:1:1423404001:1.source_cn: 卫兵们看上去都在努力忍受痛苦……

say:2:1423404002:0.text: Magister, let's get that ointment ready now. Chippy really wants to see them back on their feet!
say:2:1423404002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们现在就帮他们熬制伤药吧，满满想看到他们恢复健...
say:2:1423404002:0.male: Magister, let's get that ointment ready now. Chippy really wants to see them back on their feet!
say:2:1423404002:0.female: Magister, let's get that ointment ready now. Chippy really wants to see them back on their feet!

document:3:245:0.text: Peel the <style="highlight">grimberry</style> and mash the flesh into a juicy pulp. Add the <style="highlight">rock moss</style> and grind clockwise until fully dissolved. Finally, remove the stems from the <style="highlight">fuzzy mushroom</style>, add them to the mixture, and simmer gently before letting it cool.
document:3:245:0.source_cn: 将<style="highlight">苦叶果</style>去皮处理，果肉锤捣成汁液状。 加入<style="highlight">石髓苔藓</style>，顺时针研磨融化。最后把<style="highlight">厚褶的茸茸伞菇</style>切除菌柄，加入汁液中慢煮后冷却。
document:3:245:0.male: Peel the <style="highlight">grimberry</style> and mash the flesh into a juicy pulp. Add the <style="highlight">rock moss</style> and grind clockwise until fully dissolved. say:11:1423404003:0.text: All done! Let's hand these out to the guards!
say:11:1423404003:0.source_cn: 伤药熬好啦，我们把伤药分给卫兵们吧！
